decision: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
fact: The following Power Unit elements have been used: 3rd Energy Store (ES) 3rd Control Electronics (CE) All Power Unit elements were replaced without the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate during Parc Ferme.
offence: Breaches of Articles 28.2 and 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
reason: The Power Unit elements used are in excess of the permitted number for the 2024 Championship season. This is a breach of Article 28.2 and incurs a grid penalty in accordance with Article 28.3. The parts have been replaced without the approval of the Technical Delegate, this being a breach of Article 40.3. Therefore Car 23 is required to start the Race from pit lane in accordance with Article 40.9. Due to the fact that the car is required to start from the Pit Lane, the grid penalty does not come into effect.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 23 Changes Made During Parc Ferme
